title: Permuting the input of a function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a set, let $n$ be a natural number, let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the $n$ coordinate positions, and let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The function obtained by permuting the input of $f$ sends $x$ to the value of $f$ at the input whose $i$th coordinate is $x(\sigma(i))$.
